a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.text: The name's Gordon. Good day to you.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.player: It's a nice farm you've got here.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.text: Thank you. We built it ourselves.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.player: Really? So you haven't been here long?

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.text: Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. But then some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.text: Lord Hosidius made a deal with Lord Shayzien and the lizardmen were cleared out to make room for the Farming Guild.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon.text: When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.

steps.text: If the player does not have the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: I think we're good. Thank you for the offer though.
If the player has the requirements to start the quest:

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: Well actually, there is something we've been having a problem with.

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: Recently, some strange beast has been stealing our livestock at night. The soldiers are too busy dealing with the lizardmen to help, so we haven't been able to stop it.

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: You look like you know your way around a weapon. If you can kill the beast and bring me its head as proof, I'll ensure you are compensated for your trouble.

steps.player: Bring back the head? I can do that. I'm good at killing things. Do you know where the beast is?

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: Well it can't be living too far from here, but I don't know exactly where. You might want to check with my wife, Mary. Perhaps she's seen something I haven't.

steps.player: Very well. I'll return once I have the head of this beast!
Not something I can help with I'm afraid. Good luck though.

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: I understand. I'm sure someone else will be able to help.

options.text: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.

steps.player: Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: Thank you friend. See you later.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-talkin.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-talkin.text: Hello there. Not too bad, thanks.

options.text: Great to hear. All the best.

steps.player: Great to hear. All the best.

steps.speaker: Gordon
steps.text: Thank you friend. See you later.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-talkin.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-talkin.text: Hello again. Any luck finding that beast?

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-talkin.player: I've been trying, but I haven't made much progress yet.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-talkin.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-talkin.text: Well it can't be living too far from here. You might want to check with my wife, Mary. Perhaps she's seen something I haven't.

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.player: I'm [player name]. Your husband told me that some beast has been causing you both trouble. I've agreed to kill it and bring back its head!

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.speaker: Mary
a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.text: Ah, that's good to hear. We've already lost a lot of livestock to it.

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.player: Well fear not. I'm sure I'll make short work of it. I do have one issue, however.
I don't yet know where to find this beast. I was wondering if you'd seen anything?

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.speaker: Mary
a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.text: I'm afraid not. It only ever comes in the night, so we haven't been able to get a proper look at it.

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.speaker: Mary
a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.text: Oh! I have an idea! If this beast ended up getting coated in flour, it wouldn't be hard for you to track it back to its home.

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.player: But how would I get it coated in flour?

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.speaker: Mary
a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.text: Oh come on now! You're the adventurer here! Why don't you use your head?

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.player: Use my head? Wait... Did you just...?

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.speaker: Mary
a-strange-event-talking-to-mary.text: I don't know what you mean.

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary-talking-.speaker: Mary
a-strange-event-talking-to-mary-talking-.text: Hello there. How goes the headhunt?

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary-talking-.player: I'm still trying to come up with a way to cover the beast in flour.

a-strange-event-talking-to-mary-talking-.speaker: Mary
a-strange-event-talking-to-mary-talking-.text: Well I'm sure you'll think of something. Just remember to use your head.

a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.player: Hello. Do you know anything about the beast causing trouble around here?

a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.speaker: Sergeant
a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.text: The farmers mentioned it. We haven't seen anything though. Our focus is on the lizardmen.

a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.player: Surely you'd notice a big beast wondering around though?

a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.speaker: Sergeant
a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.text: The farmers said it came at night. We're not on shift then.

a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.player: But then who's guarding the farm at night?

a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.speaker: Sergeant
a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.text: That's not our problem. We're just here to follow orders.

a-strange-event-talking-to-the-sergeant.player: Fine. I'll find the beast myself.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Hello again. Any luck finding that beast?

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-after-.player: I've been trying, but I haven't made much progress yet.
Just one question. You said this beast has been going for your livestock. Which animals has it been targeting?

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: It's mainly been going for the cattle. I fixed up a new gate which has kept it out the past couple of nights. Not sure how long it will hold though.

a-strange-event-talking-to-gordon-after-.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

a-strange-event-pouring-the-flour-on-the.text: You pour some flour over the gate.

a-strange-event-pouring-the-flour-on-the.player: There we go. Anything that touches this gate will end up coated in flour. Now just to wait for the beast to come...

a-strange-event-pouring-the-flour-on-the.text: You head off for the night and come back the next day.

a-strange-event-pouring-the-flour-on-the.player: Looks like the beast tried to get in again. Now to see if the flour plan worked...

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Hello again. Any luck finding that beast?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.player: Your wife gave me a good idea to help track it down. I'll have its head soon enough!

a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-po.speaker: Mary
a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-po.text: Hello there. How goes the headhunt?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-po.player: The flour idea worked great. Now I just need to find the beast's home.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-po.speaker: Mary
a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-po.text: Well keep your head up. I'm sure you'll manage it.

a-strange-beast-upon-killing-the-headles.player: Ah... a headless beast. Can't really bring back the head if there isn't one. Let's hope Gordon is still happy to reward me...

a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-ki.speaker: Mary
a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-ki.text: Hello there. How goes the headhunt?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-ki.player: I've run into a little issue. The beast is dead, but it didn't have a head.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-ki.speaker: Mary
a-strange-beast-talking-to-mary-after-ki.text: Oh dear. You should probably talk to Gordon about this.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Hello again. Any luck finding that beast?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Wonderful! Do you have the head?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.player: So it didn't actually have a head.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: I'm sorry, but no. I agreed to pay you for a head and you don't have one.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.player: Well actually I do have a head. Quite a good looking one in fact. It was the beast that didn't.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: That's not what I meant. Look, it's nothing personal, but I can't be seen paying someone if they didn't do the job.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.player: But I did the job... How am I meant to bring you the head of a beast with no head?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Maybe you killed the wrong beast? It doesn't make sense that a headless beast would be taking cattle. How would it eat them?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Well if you manage to get hold of the beast's head, let me know. Until then, I can't pay you.

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Hello again. Do you have the head of that beast yet?

a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-talking-to-gordon-after-.text: Well I can't pay you if you don't have the head.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-ne.text: You show the journal to Gordon.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-ne.player: I don't have the head of the beast. I do have proof it was headless though.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-ne.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-ne.text: Proof? This doesn't seem like proof to me. Anyone could have written this. Maybe you wrote it?

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-ne.player: You assume I can read and write.
Well.. yes. I promise I didn't write this though.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-ne.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-ne.text: Well you would say that. I'm sorry but I'm not having this. Come back when you have the head of the beast.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-bi.text: You show the bones to Gordon.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-bi.player: I don't have the head of the beast. I do have the bones though!

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-bi.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-bi.text: Bones? I don't want bones! I want the beast's head!

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-bi.player: Have you considered that you might be being too picky?

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-bi.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-bi.text: Of course not! Besides, these bones could be from anywhere.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-en.text: You show the ensouled head to Gordon.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-en.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof!
This is literally the head of a dead bear. What is wrong with you?

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-en.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-en.text: I can see this is the head of a bear! This beast we're dealing with is more than a mere bear though!

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-en.player: What? You said you'd never seen the beast! How do you know it wasn't just a bear?

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-en.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-en.text: We've dealt with bears before! This is clearly something more! Now, go and find the real beast!

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-be.text: You show the fake bearhead to Gordon.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-be.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof!

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-be.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-be.text: What? But this is clearly just part of a costume!

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-be.player: Maybe it didn't have any brains.

a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-be.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-beast-using-items-on-gordon-be.text: The only thing without brains is you! Come back once you have the actual head!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.text: Hello there. How goes the headhunt?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.player: I've run into a little issue. The beast is dead, but it didn't have a head. Your husband says he won't pay me until I bring him one.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.text: Oh dear. I'm afraid Gordon can be quite picky sometimes.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.player: But what do I do now? I can't bring him a head if there isn't one.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.text: Well, between you and me, Gordon is a good farmer but I wouldn't say he's a genius by any means. He also doesn't actually know what the beast looks like.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.player: So I make him a fake head! Great idea!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.text: That's the spirit! I've tried my hand at clay modelling in the past. You can make all sorts of things. Just get some soft clay and a knife and I'm sure you'll be able to make a lovely head.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.text: Hello there. Any luck with that head?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-kil.text: Keep at it! I've tried my hand at clay modelling in the past. You can make all sorts of things. Just get some soft clay and a knife and I'm sure you'll be able to make a lovely head.

a-strange-fake-making-the-clay-head.text: You sculpt the clay into the shape of a head.

a-strange-fake-making-the-clay-head.player: Still, maybe it will be enough to convince Gordon.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.text: Hello there. Any luck with that head?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.player: I've made a head out of clay.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.text: Wonderful! You should show it to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-using-the-clay-head-on-go.text: You show the clay head to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-using-the-clay-head-on-go.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Hello again. Do you have the head of that beast yet?
You show the clay head to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Its head? This is its head?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: But this just looks like clay... It feels like clay...
As you talk to Gordon, part of the clay falls off.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: It's falling apart... What creature is this?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: Ah yes! A good question! A very good question! A good question in need of a good answer I'm sure!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Okay... So what is the answer?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: Yes... well... This is the head of a... a claybear!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Claybear? There's no such thing!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Quite rare because they don't exist! I'm no fool, this is clearly a pretend head! It doesn't even have any fur!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Come back once you have the real head of the beast!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Do you have the head of that beast yet? Or do you just have more clay?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: No head, no pay.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.text: Hello there. Any luck with that head?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.player: I made a head out of clay. Gordon didn't buy it though.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.text: Oh dear. Keep trying. I'm sure with a few tweaks you can make a head that will convince him.

a-strange-fake-making-the-fur-head.text: You attach the fur to the clay head.

a-strange-fake-making-the-fur-head.player: It somehow looks even worse than before!
Gordon said it needed fur though. Maybe he'll be happy with this one.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.text: Hello there. Any luck with that head?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.player: I made a head out of clay. Gordon didn't buy it though, so I've now added some fur.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.text: Wonderful! You should show it to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-using-the-fur-head-on-gor.text: You show the fur head to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-using-the-fur-head-on-gor.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof! For real this time!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Do you have the head of that beast yet? Or do you just have more clay?
You show the fur head to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof! For real this time!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Well there's fur this time. It does look like an actual head, I have to admit.
It really doesn't, but you let Gordon continue.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Yes, I think this is the head of a beast.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Well hang on just a moment...

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Where's the blood? If this is a fresh kill, the head should have blood on.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: Ah... Yes... Well the thing about this head is that this is the head of a...

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Yes?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Bloodbear? What's a bloodbear?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: It's a rare type of bear. One that doesn't have any blood.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: It's called a bloodbear but it doesn't have blood? Did a fool name it?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: Well actually the one that named it is quite the intellectual... Very cool as well... not that I know them or anything.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: You must take me for an idiot! This is some head you bought from a taxidermist or something. It's clearly not a fresh kill!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Come back once you have the real head!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Do you have the head of that beast yet? Or do you just have more fakes?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: No head, no reward. Come back once you have it!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.text: Hello there. Any luck with that head?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.player: Gordon didn't buy the clay head so I tried adding some fur. He still wasn't convinced though.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-sho.text: Well I'm sure you're not far off. Keep it up!

a-strange-fake-using-a-vial-of-blood-or-.text: That would be a terrible waste. Perhaps there's something better you can use.

a-strange-fake-making-the-bloody-head.text: You dye the fur head red.

a-strange-fake-making-the-bloody-head.player: Well... it doesn't. It actually looks like someone tried to dye a fur covered clay monstrosity red.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.text: Hello there. Any luck with that head?

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.player: Gordon didn't buy the clay head so I tried adding some fur. He still wasn't convinced so I've dyed it red to make it look bloody.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.speaker: Mary
a-strange-fake-talking-to-mary-after-mak.text: Wonderful! I'm sure this will convince him. You should show him what you've got.

a-strange-fake-using-the-bloody-head-on-.text: You show the bloody head to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-using-the-bloody-head-on-.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof... Again!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Do you have the head of that beast yet? Or do you just have more fakes?
You show the bloody head to Gordon.

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.player: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof... Again!

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.text: Hmm...

a-strange-fake-talking-to-gordon-after-m.speaker: Gordon
